Economics: Considered good sport fish and food fish in some areas.
Name: Green Sunfish - Lepomis cyanellus
Habitat: Probably introduced species. Inhabits wide variety of
habitats. Likes backwaters of streams.
Foods: Insects, molluscs, crustaceans, small fish.
Economics: Not a good sportfish except for young anglers. Provides
forage for predators.
Name: Sauger - Stizostedion canadense
Habitat: Montana native. Prefer large lakes and rivers that are
turbid.
Foods: Small fish (any species), crayfish, aquatic insects.
Economics: Prized game fish.
Sources: Dames and Moore 1975, and Brown 1971.
